thread:
Maria: FYI deploybot failed to finalize publish for image `redwood/core-api:2026-03-19-rc4` — partial layer upload in us-west-2, attestation timed out.
Alex: Where did it fail? logs?
deploybot: [automated] Publish step `push_layers` returned 408 on layer sha256:abcd1234efgh...; attestation upload delayed; registry returned 202 for manifest but mirror reports missing layer checksum.
Olivia: If manifest was accepted but a layer is missing in EU mirror, we might leak a half-published tag to consumers. Not good.
Jake: Can we pin back to the previous digest? CI shows previous stable digest is `sha256:1111deadbeef`.
Maria: I think we should block the release window until this is resolved. Release window closes in ~2h.
Alex: Propose immediate rollback strategy: retag previous digest to the public tag, then revoke/clean the failing manifest where possible. Retag avoids kludgy manifests.
SRE-Oncall: Retagging is safest. We'll need a short change window and a deploy freeze for canaries. Recommend 5-min window and ops notification.
Olivia: Also validate provenance: cosign signatures differ between us-west-2 and eu-west-1. That suggests the eu mirror didn't get the attestation or the blob.
deploybot: To execute retag: `./tools/deploybot retag --from-digest sha256:1111deadbeef --to-tag rc4 --regions us-west-2,eu-west-1` — dry run passed for staging, will attempt production on approval.
Maria: Plan: 1) Pause canary/automated deploys 2) Pin running workloads to previous digest via a quick k8s manifest patch (immediate) 3) Schedule retag in 20m 4) Postmortem and release notes follow-up.
Alex: I'll open a PR to patch k8s Deployments with the digest pin. Small PR, high priority.
Jake: Add release note blurb: "Published image failed attestation in EU mirror; pinned to prior digest; follow-up: investigate registry mirror consistency."
Olivia: Assigning infra: @SRE-Oncall, @eng-infra for mirror parity check and blob availability.
SRE-Oncall: Acknowledged. Starting a mirror parity job and checking S3 replication logs.
ci-bot: build/1234 - retag job queued.
deploybot: Retag executed at 1719854500 — success in us-west-2; eu-west-1 returned ERR_LAYER_MISSING for blob sha256:abcd1234efgh... Manual copy required to eu mirror.
Maria: Manual blob copy to eu mirror in progress (scp to staging-bucket then rsync to mirror). ETA ~12m.
Alex: After the blob copy we must re-run cosign attestation push. Who has signing key access?
Jake: I have the signing key; coordinating with security to push attestation once parity confirmed.
Olivia: Note for postmortem: observed intermittent S3 eventual-consistency during cross-region replication at time of publish; may explain missing blob in eu mirror.
SRE-Oncall: Parity check done — blob present after copy. Re-running manifest acceptance and attestation push.
deploybot: Cosign attestation push completed; eu-west-1 accepted manifest at 1719854785.
Maria: Canaries resumed. Observed successful pulls in eu and us.
Alex: I'll update the release notes and include the rollback/pin instructions and timing.
Jake: Postmortem owner: @Olivia. I'll add the short timeline and include S3 replication logs.
Olivia: Root cause suspected: transient S3 replication lag combined with race in our multi-region publish flow. Action items: 1) add mirror parity pre-check to publish job 2) add retry/backoff on attestation push 3) infra to investigate S3 replication metrics.
Maria: Closing thread — retag/rollback completed, canaries resumed, release window preserved. Follow-up doc in PR #452.
